main.description: Birth chart calculation inputs. The record key 'self' holds the author's own chart; any other key (a TID) holds someone else's.

name.description: Who the chart belongs to, e.g. 'Mum'. Usually omitted on the 'self' record.

bornAt.description: Birth instant. When isBirthTimeKnown is false, local noon in timeZone.

isBirthTimeKnown.description: Whether the birth time is known and disclosed.

aiPreferences.description: Chart-specific AI preferences. Aster treats omitted preferences, including inference, as denied. Inference covers sending chart data to an AI model, including a hosted LLM, to generate text such as a horoscope.
